composition.subject_anchor_priority: environment-first scale lock: the complete tray cluster remains inside a 0.50-wide by 0.31-high envelope; the exact right-front beverage stays 0.13-0.15 frame width and 0.15-0.18 frame height

environment.background_plane: a new low-detail lived-in room that carries broad architectural daylight without reproducing identifiable reference furnishings

material_rules.glass: each vessel is regenerated with a readable rim, base, thickness, refraction, local condensation and physically attached contact under the target camera and light

coupling_rules: Exactly one user beverage occupies the right-front target and stays 0.13-0.15 of frame width and 0.15-0.18 of frame height; if uncertain, render it smaller.
One generic unbranded left-front drink and one plain unbranded rear-center carafe complete the unequal triangular relation.
All three items rest physically on one complete round dark tray spanning 0.44-0.50 of frame width and at most 0.31 frame height.
The selected container design is reconstructed under the target camera and light rather than preserving source pixels or boundary.
The tray remains darker than the white table while preserving subdued grain and local base reflections.
Hard architectural daylight remains behind the table; the tray stays in open shade with broad window bounce.

round tray width or silhouette leaves the target range
